chunks: And Abu Ja'far عليه السلام said:

"Whoever walks with a funeral procession until salat is performed over it and then returns shall have one qirat. And if he walks with it until it is buried, he shall have two qirats, and one qirat is like Mount Uhud."

key_terms.جَبَلِ أُحُدٍ: Mount Uhud, used here to illustrate the vast magnitude of the reward
key_terms.جَنَازَةٍ: a funeral procession or bier of the deceased
key_terms.قِيرَاطٌ: a measure of immense spiritual reward

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for walking with a funeral procession until the prayer or burial?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the great reward for accompanying a جنازة and participating in the rites owed to the deceased. It distinguishes between accompanying the funeral until the funeral prayer and remaining until burial, showing that the reward increases with fuller participation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.452 - Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said:

"Whoever walks with a funeral procession until the funeral prayer is offered and then returns will receive one qirat (measure of reward). If they continue walking with it until the deceased is buried, they will receive two qirats, and one qirat is like the size of Mount Uhud."
